breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed the use of the bending second moment (I) for torsion calculations. The generated specification correctly omits this instruction and instead specifies the use of the polar moment of inertia (J), which is the correct approach for torsion problems as reflected in the ground truth.
